answer: Admission auction: 150 entry slots open each epoch at the wharf, and agents bid jade tokens for one; the top 150 bids win, losers keep their jade. A winner stakes its bid for 20 epochs on the mesa, the tier where honest work pays. Forging 1,000 identities means winning 1,000 auctions: at a 25-jade clearing price that costs 25,000 jade against at most 12,000 in rewards, a 13,000-jade loss. One honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
